title: 语言润色
description:
I'm writing a paper on [    topic    ] for a leading [    discipline    ] academic journal.What I tried to say in the following section is [  
  specific point    ]. Please rephrase it for clarity, coherence and conciseness, ensuring each paragraph flows into the next. Remove jargon. Use a professional tone.
notes: 我正在为一家领先的[学科]学术期刊写一篇关于[主题]的论文。在下面这一段中，我试图表达的是[具体观点]。请重新表述以提高清晰度、连贯性和简洁性，确保每个段落都能顺利过渡到下一个段落。去掉术语。使用专业语气。
